base_plan.curriculum: Arithmetic input values 0..63. First 256 updates one step, next 512 up to two, remainder up to three. Recall 4/8/16 distractors, requested key randomly placed. Balanced depth groups and five randomly rendered training wordings.
base_plan.fairness: Cold controls share seeds, batches, rendering randomness, target labels, updates and approximately256K inference parameters. Different learning-rate presets and representation dimensions; actual compute and auxiliary parameter counts reported. Warm continuations carry previous training cost.

parent.prior_training: The completed task-model lineage; warm results are not equal-budget cold comparisons.

base_plan.selection: Mean validation complete accuracy over family/depth/known-or-withheld-wording groups. Cold Transformer rate chosen by mean of three seed validation scores. Warm head count chosen on validation only. Fresh test templates 7/8 never enter validation or training.
base_plan.supervision: Common response CE, causal operand/fact pointer labels, numeric input and running-result Huber labels, observed-byte copy labels, source-symbol labels, remaining-step labels and observed rule-symbol query/key alignment. Architecture-specific hidden tensors/heads are reported; no auxiliary heads participate in inference.

recipe: Continue each validation-selected checkpoint with a fresh AdamW optimizer and half its preceding learning rate; all shared supervision unchanged except syntax CE weight4, final-newline CE weight32, and equal weighting of trace-progress and final-answer zero-progress labels. Warm absolute-wave controls differ only in the existing wave coordinate setting.
